d: Cabinet in the inn of Taddeo. Teodoro who in magnificent dress as a melancholy and thoughtful room sits at a coffee table, and Gafforio under the name of Garbolino; then Taddeo with the bill. Indi Lisetta with coffee.
Room in the inn mentioned above. Lisetta that irons the linens and other Donzelle used in various works, and then Sandrino.
Acmet in Armenian dress followed by his servants dressed in the same manner and Sandrino, who carefully observes it in the performance.
Belisa with Sandrino, and Lisetta on the side.
Sandrino alone, and then Taddeo and Lisetta.
Belisa pulling Acmet's arm, and sayings.
Cabinet. Teodoro sitting at a coffee table and Gafforio with a bundle of letters.
Teodoro, and then Taddeo with Lisetta.
Delli and Sandrino, who comes up half a third and stays back to hear.

Outside part of the inn with a view of the Rialto Bridge and its surroundings. People above the bridge and on the road. Gondolas on the Grand Canal passing under the bridge, and other boats that stand still. Teodoro with Lisetta and Acmet with pipe in the company of Belisa above the terrace of the inn; Gafforio and Taddeo on the road.
Gafforio and Taddeo on the road.
Belisa and Acmet, following his servants, and Taddeo.
Cabinet. Thoughtful theodor sits over a chair at a coffee table, and Gafforio.

Grand Atrium in the inn supported by a double order of columns. In the back balustrade that corresponds on the Grand Canal, on which you can see gondolas and quite another lot of boats. Servants that prepare the table. Sandrino alone, and then Taddeo.
Acmet with Belisa coming down from the gondola at the bottom of the atrium, served by Taddeo.
Theodoro with Gafforio, indi Lisetta, and sayings.
Messer Great with followers of People of righteousness and sayings.
Outside prison. Theodorus in prison, and all one after the other in the atrium before the prison, visible by means of ironates.
